lines.2: I thought back to what had happened at lunch.
lines.3: The Princess's hand had been so white and soft.
lines.4: I gazed intently at my own hand.
lines.6: Still, losing at arm wrestling really stung.
lines.9: If I truly wanted to grow close to the Princess, I had to improve myself.
lines.11: There was something strangely surreal about watching a beautiful woman clip her nails.
lines.14: 「The Princess is really strong at arm wrestling.」
lines.15: 「Is she? I can beat her with two fingers.」
lines.16: 「...Then I have a question for mighty Otome.」
lines.17: 「Is there some way to pack on solid muscle in a short time?」
lines.18: 「No. Study and training both bear fruit through steady effort.」
lines.21: She handed me a spare pair of nail clippers.
lines.22: 「Clip your nails. Long nails are unhygienic.」
lines.24: I needed to take care of basic things like this too.
lines.25: The two of us clipping our nails side by side was just as surreal.
lines.26: 「When you finish, go do some roadwork. If you want muscle, put in the work every day.」
lines.29: Damn it. I really had to work at this.
lines.33: 「...I praise you once and this is what happens. There is no point talking to you.」
lines.34: 「Maybe that's just the kind of character you are, Otome.」
lines.36: 「Why are you so battered? If someone's bullying you, tell me who and I'll kill--」
lines.37: 「My sister had one of her fits.」
lines.38: 「Yeah, nothing I can do about that.」
lines.39: 「Don't say 'sister.' You're going to trigger my trauma.」
lines.42: 「...I know I keep asking, but do you really have to keep doing that?」
lines.43: 「You need money, don't you? No matter what you want to do.」
lines.45: 「Don't look so serious. I chose this because I wanted to.」
lines.46: Subaru gave my shoulder a couple of pats.
lines.47: 「You just go enjoy a proper youth, okay?」
lines.49: 「Man... I hate this awkward mood whenever Subaru leaves for work.」
lines.50: 「Yeah. I wish we could get him back on the straight and narrow. Getting paid to keep lonely older women company is basically a crime.」
lines.52: 「Remember when we offered him the money we'd saved from our own jobs? He wouldn't take it.」
lines.53: 「Yeah. We even said it could be a loan instead of a gift, and he still refused.」
lines.54: 「It's not as if that's the only way he could make money. Subaru must have his own reason why he can't quit.」
lines.56: 「It can't be that simple. If he were that sex-crazed, he'd be fooling around with all the girls at school who throw themselves at him.」
lines.58: 「Then maybe some of that attention would've spilled over to me.」
lines.60: 「The point is, this isn't something we get to decide for him.」
lines.62: Maybe Fukahire was more mature than I'd given him credit for.
lines.63: 「By the way, have you made any private progress with the Princess?」
lines.64: 「No... It's way too soon for that.」
lines.66: No. He was still just a creep.
